description: This file contains classes and methods for updating dashboards in the Superset project, including handling native filters, chart customizations, color configurations, and tab management with email notifications for report deactivations.

classes.name: UpdateDashboardCommand
classes.description: Main class for updating dashboard properties, handling validation, tab diff processing, and tag updates.

classes.name: UpdateDashboardNativeFiltersCommand
classes.description: Handles updating native filters configuration for dashboards.

classes.name: UpdateDashboardChartCustomizationsCommand
classes.description: Handles updating chart customizations for dashboards.

classes.name: UpdateDashboardColorsConfigCommand
classes.description: Handles updating color configurations for dashboards.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the update process, wrapped in a transaction, for each command class.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates dashboard existence, ownership, slug uniqueness, owners, tags, and roles.

methods.name: process_tab_diff
methods.description: Detects deleted tabs, finds related reports, deactivates reports, and sends notification emails.
